notes: Only outcome values that Deloitte itself reported in later editions are recorded here, with Deloitte as the source. They are Deloitte's figures, not independent measurements, and are not grades. No independent outcome data was collected in this pass.

values.subject: Open RAN and network virtualization
values.metric: global active public-network Open RAN deployments and trials
values.source_note: Deloitte TMT Predictions 2025, Updates article; also states only two networks globally are multivendor Open RAN.

values.subject: 5G standalone networks
values.metric: mobile operators that have deployed, launched or soft-launched 5G SA
values.predicted: >=200 operators investing (trials, planned or actual) by end-2023
values.source_note: Deloitte TMT Predictions 2025, Updates article. The metrics differ: the prediction counted operators investing (including trials and plans); the reported value counts deployments and launches.

values.subject: Fixed wireless access
values.predicted: ~88 million in 2022; under 100 million in 2023 (as restated by Deloitte)
values.source_note: Deloitte says actual growth has been 'roughly in line' with its 2022 prediction.

values.subject: Direct-to-device satellite connectivity
values.metric: spending on D2D network infrastructure in 2024
values.source_note: Deloitte TMT Predictions 2026 overview: 'Deloitte predicted spending ... at $3 billion in 2024, but it reached around $4 billion'. The 2024 edition entry captured here quotes a different headline number (over 200 million satellite-capable smartphones sold).
